fact: From 3 to 7 November 2025 the Countdown to 2030 country collaboration in Mauritania, with APHRC, held a national workshop training district-level SNIS focal points to analyse and use routine SNIS data, with practical sessions in Excel and DHIS2, at which participants identified reporting gaps and inconsistencies.
title: Strengthening the Use of SRMNIA-Nutrition Data for Action in Mauritania
